title: FDA Drug, Medical Device & Food Recall Radar Input

domain.title: FDA Product Domain
domain.description: Select which openFDA enforcement domain(s) to monitor: all domains in parallel, Medical Devices, Drugs, or Food/Dietary Supplements.

searchQuery.title: Product Keyword / Brand / Reason
searchQuery.description: Search across product description, recall reason, brand name, or device name (e.g. 'catheter', 'pacemaker', 'listeria', 'insulin').

recallingFirm.title: Recalling Firm / Manufacturer
recallingFirm.description: Filter by manufacturer, distributor, or recalling firm name (e.g. 'Medtronic', 'Pfizer', 'Abbott').

classification.title: FDA Hazard Classification
classification.description: Class I = reasonable probability of serious adverse health consequences or death; Class II = medically reversible; Class III = unlikely harm.

status.title: Recall Enforcement Status
status.description: Filter by ongoing active recalls, completed, or terminated recalls.

state.title: Recalling Firm US State (2 letters)
state.description: Optional two-letter US state abbreviation of the recalling firm (e.g. 'CA', 'TX', 'IL', 'NJ').

reportDateFrom.title: Reported On or After (YYYY-MM-DD)
reportDateFrom.description: Optional minimum FDA Enforcement Report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-01-01').

maxRecords.title: Maximum Recall Records
maxRecords.description: Maximum number of merged recall alerts to return (1–200).

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose between detailed recall dataset records or a compact MCP risk summary.
